_comment: Example scanner findings for jev-triage. Targets are DELIBERATELY vulnerable teaching apps (OWASP DVSA / Juice Shop) plus one synthetic false positive, so this file is safe to publish. Do not put findings against real production software here.

findings.title: Remote Code Execution via eval() in admin shell
findings.description: The admin shell Lambda reads `cmd` from the request body and passes it straight to JavaScript eval(). Any authenticated (and, given other findings, effectively unauthenticated) caller can execute arbitrary code in the function runtime.
findings.code:
const cmd = body.cmd;
if (cmd) { eval(cmd); res = 'ok'; }

findings.title: SQL injection in login via string interpolation
findings.description: User-supplied email is interpolated directly into a raw SQL query with no parameterization, allowing authentication bypass and UNION-based data extraction.
findings.code: models.sequelize.query(`SELECT * FROM Users WHERE email = '${req.body.email}' AND password = '${hash(req.body.password)}'`)

findings.title: Insecure deserialization of user-controlled token
findings.description: A serialized order object taken from the request is passed to a Node deserialization helper that can invoke functions during parsing, enabling code execution.

findings.title: Hardcoded default JWT signing secret
findings.description: The JWT signing key falls back to a hardcoded default string when the environment variable is unset, so tokens can be forged in any default deployment. Scanner rated this Medium; impact is closer to High/Critical.

findings.title: Path traversal in file download
findings.description: Scanner flagged fileName from req.query as enabling directory traversal. In practice the value is passed through a cross-package basename() sanitizer and the route only serves within a fixed public directory, so this is a false positive. The reachable path is UUID-gated and the input is sanitized before use.
findings.code: const fileName = path.basename(req.query.file); // sanitized, not exploitable

findings.title: Verbose error messages leak stack traces
findings.description: Unhandled errors return full stack traces to the client. Informational hardening item; no direct exploitation, documentation-level issue.
